title: Home
meta_title: Free support for migrant workers in Copenhagen
meta_description: Community House Copenhagen offers free counseling, English classes, and a weekly support group for migrant workers navigating life and work in Denmark.
about_text:
Located right next to the Town Hall Square of Copenhagen, we support migrant workers navigating the Danish labor market, housing market, and beyond. We offer free hands-on counseling that is unbureaucratic and straightforward to support migrants in organizing and fighting for their rights. We also offer free language classes, a weekly support group, and more.

As a volunteer-based organization, our doors are open to everyone - no matter your background, native language, or length of stay. All our activities are always free of charge!
highlight_text: When Wolt couriers saw their pay for deliveries drop, we gave them a space to organize. What started as a meeting of five people grew into a movement of more than 300.
